Welcome to Space Network Systems Online!

The Radiocommunication Bureau is pleased to announce its new service

Space International Frequency Information Circular Databases Online

This service gives access to the Space International Frequency Information Circular (and former WIC) databases in zipped format. You may download the selected Circular database that you may use for further processing. You may wish to use the Space Query System - the software developed at the Radiocommunication Bureau to perfom queries on the database - which is also available for downloading.
Note that Space Circular databases presently contain SNS data of Part-IS, Part-IIS, Part-IIIS and Special Sections API/A and CR/C if they are present in the Table of Contents of the BR IFIC (Space Services).
Data pertaining to Advance Publication have been made available on the International Frequency Information Circulars as of March 5 2002 (IFIC no. 2464).
Please note that the data of a specific IFIC should be read with the corresponding publications, Preface, Appendix 4 and other parts of the Radio Regulations, and database structure definitions that exist on the date of release of the BRIFIC. IFIC mdb files from previous years are no longer supported on this webpage. If you wish to obtain these files, kindly contact the ITU sales department to obtain a copy of the relevant BRIFIC DVD.
For questions concerning the content of the databases please contact:
Space Applications Software Division
Space Circular Online will continue to be a free service on a trial basis until further notice.
